@demo/global/screen.documentation: 2D drawing API. Origin (0,0) is the center of the screen. 1 unit = 100 pixels.

@demo/global/screen.clear.documentation: Clears the screen with a color.

@demo/global/screen.clear/param/0.documentation: Optional color string, e.g. "#0f1115". Defaults to black.

@demo/global/screen.setColor.documentation: Sets the current color used by fill/stroke.

@demo/global/screen.setAlpha.documentation: Sets global alpha for subsequent draws. 0.0 to 1.0.

@demo/global/screen.setBlending.documentation: Sets the blending mode. Modes: normal, additive, multiply, screen, overlay, darken, lighten, difference, exclusion, hue, saturation, color, luminosity.

@demo/global/screen.setFont.documentation: Sets the font used for text drawing.

@demo/global/screen.setPixelated.documentation: Disables image smoothing (useful for pixel art).

@demo/global/screen.setPixelated/param/0.documentation: true to disable smoothing, false to enable.

@demo/global/screen.setLineWidth.documentation: Sets the stroke line width in units.

@demo/global/screen.setCursorVisible.documentation: Shows or hides the mouse cursor.

@demo/global/screen.setCursorVisible/par.documentation: true to show, false to hide.

@demo/global/screen.fillRect.documentation: Fills a rectangle. (x, y) is the center.

@demo/global/screen.drawRect.documentation: Draws the outline of a rectangle.

@demo/global/screen.drawRound.documentation: Draws the outline of an ellipse.

@demo/global/screen.drawRoundRect.documentation: Draws the outline of a rounded rectangle.

@demo/global/screen.drawLine.documentation: Draws a line from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2).

@demo/global/screen.drawText.documentation: Draws centered text. Size is in units (0.2 = 20 pixels).

@demo/global/screen.textWidth.documentation: Returns the width of a text string in units.

@demo/global/screen.drawSprite.documentation: Draws a sprite registered in the sprites table.

@demo/global/screen.drawImage.documentation: Draws a PForgeImage at the given position.

@demo/global/keyboard.documentation: Keyboard input state. 1 if key is held, 0 otherwise.

@demo/global/keyboard.press.documentation: 1 only on the frame the key was pressed.

@demo/global/keyboard.release.documentation: 1 only on the frame the key was released.

@demo/global/mouse.documentation: Mouse input state. Coordinates are in units, origin at screen center.

@demo/global/mouse.press.documentation: 1 only on the frame of the click.

@demo/global/mouse.release.documentation: 1 only on the frame the button was released.

@demo/global/touch.touching.documentation: 1 if there is an active touch.

@demo/global/touch.x.documentation: X position of the first touch.

@demo/global/touch.y.documentation: Y position of the first touch.

@demo/global/touch.press.documentation: 1 on the frame of the touch.

@demo/global/touch.release.documentation: 1 on the frame the touch ended.

@demo/global/gamepad.documentation: Gamepad input state. Returns 0 if no controller is connected.

@demo/global/system.time.documentation: Returns the current timestamp in milliseconds.

@demo/global/system.say.documentation: Shows a native alert with the given text.

@demo/global/system.pause.documentation: Pauses the game (no effect in Studio).

@demo/global/system.exit.documentation: Exits the game (no effect in Studio).

@demo/global/system.prompt.documentation: Shows a native text input box.

@demo/global/system.file.save.documentation: Saves an object as JSON, or a PForgeImage as PNG.

@demo/global/storage.documentation: localStorage-backed persistence. Values are serialized with JSON.stringify.

@demo/global/storage.get.documentation: Reads a stored value by name.

@demo/global/storage.get/param/1.documentation: Default value if key is missing.

@demo/global/audio.beep.documentation: Plays a sequence of notes as "NOTE OCTAVE". Notes: C, D, E, F, G, A, B. Accidentals: C#4, Bb4. Octaves -1 to 9. Also supports "tempo N" and "volume N".

@demo/global/audio.beep/param/0.documentation: Sequence string, e.g. "C4 E4 G4 C5".

@demo/global/audio.playSound.documentation: Plays a sound registered in the sounds table. Returns a handle with setVolume and stop.

@demo/global/audio.playMusic.documentation: Plays a sound registered in the music table.

@demo/global/asset_manager.documentation: Asset loading (images, JSON, text, CSV, Markdown, fonts, models, WASM).

@demo/global/asset_manager.loadImage.documentation: Loads an image asynchronously and calls the callback with a PForgeImage.

@demo/global/asset_manager.loadJSON.documentation: Fetches a JSON file and calls the callback with the parsed object.

@demo/global/asset_manager.loadText.documentation: Fetches a text file and calls the callback with the string.

@demo/global/asset_manager.loadFont.documentation: Loads a font file so it can be used with screen.setFont.

@demo/global/gfx3d.documentation: 3D graphics API (wrapper over Three.js). Call gfx3d.init() before using.

@demo/global/gfx3d.init.documentation: Creates the scene, camera and renderer. Required before any other gfx3d call.

@demo/global/gfx3d.addBox.documentation: Adds a box mesh with the given options.

@demo/global/gfx3d.addPlane.documentation: Adds a plane mesh (commonly used as ground).

@demo/global/gfx3d.setCamera.documentation: Configures the camera position, lookAt target and FOV.

@demo/global/gfx3d.moveCamera.documentation: Moves the camera by delta values.

@demo/global/gfx3d.render.documentation: Renders the scene. Call inside onDraw.

@demo/global/gfx3d.setPosition.documentation: Sets the absolute position of a mesh.

@demo/global/gfx3d.setColor.documentation: Sets the color of a mesh.

@demo/global/gfx3d.getDelta.documentation: Returns the delta time from the Three.js clock.

@demo/global/onInit.documentation: Registers a function to be called once at startup.

@demo/global/onUpdate.documentation: Registers a function called every frame. dt = delta time in seconds, frame = frame count.

@demo/global/onDraw.documentation: Registers a function called every frame for drawing.

@demo/global/PForgeImage.documentation: Offscreen canvas you can manipulate pixel by pixel. centered=true puts the origin at the center of the image.

@demo/global/PForgeImage.new/param/2.documentation: If true, origin is at image center.

@demo/global/PForgeSprite.documentation: A collection of frames (PForgeImage) with configurable FPS.

@demo/global/PForgeSprite.setFrame.documentation: Manually selects the current frame. There is no play/loop yet.

@demo/global/PForgeMap.documentation: A 2D grid of tiles. Each tile is a sprite name string or nil.

@demo/global/PForgeMap.set.documentation: Sets a tile at (x, y) to the given sprite name or nil.

@demo/global/PForgeSound.documentation: Multi-channel audio buffer. Write samples manually.

@demo/global/PForgeSound.write.documentation: Writes a sample value between -1.0 and 1.0.

@demo/global/PForgeSound.play.documentation: Note: in the current runtime this is a stub. Use audio.beep for real sound.

@demo/global/sprites.documentation: Global sprite registry. Assign with sprites["name"] = sprite.

@demo/global/maps.documentation: Global tilemap registry. Assign with maps["name"] = map.

@demo/global/sounds.documentation: Global sound registry. Assign with sounds["name"] = sound.

@demo/global/music.documentation: Global music registry. Assign with music["name"] = sound.

@demo/global/after.documentation: Runs a function once after the given number of seconds.

@demo/global/every.documentation: Runs a function repeatedly every N seconds.

@demo/global/sleep.documentation: Pauses execution for the given number of seconds.

@demo/global/milliseconds.documentation: Converts a number to seconds (from milliseconds).

@demo/global/Server.documentation: Multiplayer server. Listens for client connections on a BroadcastChannel room.

@demo/global/ServerConnection.documentation: Client-side connection to a Server. Send and receive messages.
